name: record_id
description: Immutable id of one audit stage. A replay of the same payload is a duplicate.

name: correlation_id
description: Id that ties every stage of one autonomous run together.

name: decision_id
description: Decision this stage belongs to. Empty on the trigger row.

name: action_id
description: Executor action id, decision_id plus the action index. Empty except on execution.

name: sku
description: SKU the stage names, when the stage has one.

name: stage
description: trigger, evidence, decision, guard, execution, or observed.

name: trigger_ref
description: Event id that started the run.

name: evidence_refs
description: JSON array of bundle id, sku, and entity version. Not the evidence payload.

name: reason_summary
description: Short reason. Not a prompt and not a chain of thought.

name: tool_params
description: Canonical JSON of the validated action parameters.

name: simulation_id
description: Simulation that scored the decision, when one did.

name: predicted_impact
description: The decision kpi_score as JSON. -1.0 is unscored and is not a new formula.

name: execution_status
description: Executor status for this action, such as applied or not_applied.

name: observed_status
description: Verifier status: VERIFIED, REGRESSION, or INCONCLUSIVE.

name: recorded_at
description: When the trace was recorded. Partition field. Not the ingest time.

name: ingested_at
description: When the row was written. Not part of the trace identity.
